slides.title: Estate census: partial delivery, commission open

scqa: The census measured 638 of 1006 tables in scope, reading 5.9m rows in 15.5 minutes on the runtime. The result receipt is digest-verified and the ledger records a clean run.
Only 3 of 6 connections completed; 2 are partial and 1 is blocked. 44 tables failed. artists_app returned no tables because access was denied, and the grant depends on the owner.
Should the commission close on this delivery, or stay open until the blocked and partial connections are read?
Accept the delivery as a documented partial census, not as full coverage. Keep the commission open: grant access to artists_app, then re-census it together with the failed tables.
slides.title: Accept the census as a partial record, but hold the commission open for artists_app

exhibit.so_what: The method counts show how firm each part of the evidence is; they do not reconcile to the headline totals, so no coverage percentage should be taken from them.

slides.title: Complete passes carry most of the evidence; samples, failures and unreached tables remain

points: 638 of the 1006 tables in scope were measured; the rest failed or were not reached.
513 tables had a complete pass, so their figures are the firmest evidence in the census.
83 tables were measured by stratified sample and 41 by head sample, so their ratios come from part of each table.
The method counts 513, 83 and 41 do not reconcile exactly to 638. Measured does not mean exhaustively read.
slides.title: 638 of 1006 tables were measured, 513 of them by complete pass

points: 44 tables failed because the worker could not measure them in this run; they stay unmeasured until the recorded errors are addressed.
5.9m rows were read and 351.3 GiB of data and index were measured. That is the documented work performed.
259.3m rows held is an estimate and must be kept apart from the measured 5.9m rows.
15.5 minutes of wall clock is runtime context only, not a throughput guarantee or a usage charge.
slides.title: Documented work is real, but 44 failed tables keep the picture partial

slides.title: Measured data and index volume is concentrated in iebc_forms

points: 3 of 6 connections are complete, 2 are partial and 1 is blocked; 20 databases were measured.
artists_app was refused access by the database. The grant is pending, it is an owner dependency, and no tables were reached.
citizen_digital and citizen-pulse are partial: tables were reached on both, but some failed, and these feed the failed-table count of 44.
Reading artists_app alone would not resolve the partial connections or the failed tables.
slides.title: Only 3 of 6 connections completed; acceptance carries unresolved coverage

points: 3 ledger rows record admit, gate and converge, ending in success. This shows the run was governed, not that every table was fully read.
The lawful basis admit limits scope to census only. The report attributes to this the retention of aggregates, sketches and hashes only.
The executive dossier used 17679 tokens in and 4583 tokens out; this is composition usage, separate from measurement.
Separate object-storage enumeration reached 106 buckets, with 40 unreachable. It has its own receipt and is not part of the database census.
slides.title: The run is traceable end to end, but receipts prove integrity, not coverage

points: Accept the census as a partial record resting on 638 of 1006 tables; do not close the commission as complete.
Grant artists_app access and instruct a re-census; only you can clear this blocker.
Have the errors behind the 44 failed tables addressed, then re-census them with the partial connections.
Order complete passes where sampled ratios matter: 83 stratified and 41 head-sampled tables.
Have the unreconciled counts and series label clarified before any percentage is quoted.
slides.title: Accept the partial record, keep the commission open, and close the access gap first

points: 638 of 1006 tables bounds what any decision can rest on; failed and unreached tables are silent, not clear.
Ratios on the 83 stratified and 41 head-sampled tables are not whole-table measurements; a complete-pass census would close this.
Languages, rights and semantic similarity were not measured; they need rights declared at source and a separate language and similarity pass.
Digest verification and a clean ledger confirm the integrity of what was delivered; they do not remove these limits.
slides.title: Downstream decisions are bounded by reach, sampling and what was never measured
